metadata.description: Seed dataset of Namibian mining sites and projects compiled from public company/press information. Coordinates are approximate (site-level, not licence boundaries). Licence numbers, holders and expiry dates must be verified against the Ministry of Mines and Energy (MME) cadastre before any decision is made.

properties.name: Rössing Uranium Mine
properties.description: One of the world's longest-running open-pit uranium mines, located in the Namib Desert near Arandis. Life of mine extended into the 2030s.

properties.name: Husab Uranium Mine
properties.description: Large open-pit uranium mine south of Rössing; among the largest uranium producers globally.

properties.name: Langer Heinrich Uranium Mine
properties.description: Calcrete-hosted uranium deposit in the Namib-Naukluft area. Restarted production in 2024 after care & maintenance from 2018.

properties.name: Etango Uranium Project
properties.description: Large-scale alaskite-hosted uranium project; mining licence granted and early works under way.

properties.name: Tumas Uranium Project
properties.description: Calcrete-hosted uranium project near Langer Heinrich; definitive feasibility completed.

properties.name: Trekkopje Uranium Mine
properties.description: Low-grade uranium operation on care & maintenance; associated Erongo desalination plant supplies water to the region.

properties.name: Norasa (Valencia) Uranium Project
properties.description: Combined Valencia and Namibplaas deposits; feasibility-stage uranium project.

properties.name: Navachab Gold Mine
properties.description: Gold mine in the Damara Belt just south-west of Karibib.

properties.name: Twin Hills Gold Project
properties.description: Large greenfields gold discovery in the Damara Belt; acquired by Yintai Gold in 2024.

properties.name: Otjikoto Gold Mine
properties.description: Gold mine between Otjiwarongo and Otavi, includes Wolfshag underground and the Antelope deposit; also hosts a solar power plant.

properties.name: Skorpion Zinc
properties.description: Non-sulphide zinc mine and integrated refinery; mining paused in 2020, refinery conversion and pit extension under study.

properties.name: Rosh Pinah Zinc Mine
properties.description: Underground zinc-lead mine in the Gariep Belt; RP2.0 expansion project to raise throughput.

properties.name: Namdeb Land Operations
properties.holder: Namdeb Holdings (Govt of Namibia / De Beers 50:50)
properties.description: Onshore and beach diamond mining along the Sperrgebiet coast around Oranjemund.

properties.name: Debmarine Namibia – Atlantic 1
properties.holder: Debmarine Namibia (Govt of Namibia / De Beers 50:50)
properties.description: Marine diamond recovery using specialised vessels in the Atlantic 1 licence; the bulk of Namibia's diamond output. Marker is indicative only.
verify: coordinates (licence is a large offshore polygon)

properties.name: Tsumeb Smelter
properties.description: One of few smelters able to treat complex arsenic-bearing copper concentrates; acquired by Sinomine in 2023.

properties.name: Kombat Copper Mine
properties.description: Historic Otavi Mountainland copper mine being restarted; open-pit production phase followed by underground.

properties.name: Tschudi Copper Mine
properties.description: Oxide copper heap-leach operation west of Tsumeb.

properties.name: Otjihase Copper Mine
properties.description: Massive sulphide deposit on the Matchless Amphibolite Belt, north-east of Windhoek.

properties.name: Omitiomire Copper Project
properties.description: Shear-hosted copper deposit north-east of Windhoek; oxide heap-leach development planned.

properties.name: Haib Copper Project
properties.description: Large low-grade porphyry copper deposit near the Orange River border with South Africa.

properties.name: Uis Tin Mine
properties.description: Re-developed historic tin mine in the Erongo pegmatite belt; adding tantalum and lithium (petalite) products.

properties.name: Karibib Lithium (Rubicon / Helikon)
properties.description: Historic lithium pegmatite mines near Karibib with renewed interest during the battery-metals cycle.

properties.name: Lofdal Rare Earths Project
properties.description: Heavy rare earth (dysprosium, terbium) project in north-west Namibia; mining licence granted and pilot work in progress.

properties.name: Okorusu Fluorspar
properties.description: Former acid-grade fluorspar mine (closed 2014) on a carbonatite complex now of interest for rare earths.

properties.name: Okanjande Graphite
properties.description: Flake graphite deposit and plant near Otjiwarongo.

properties.name: Ohorongo Cement (Sargberg)
properties.description: Namibia's first integrated cement plant, quarrying limestone in the Otavi Mountainland.

properties.name: Otjozondu Manganese
properties.description: Historic manganese field east of Okahandja with periodic small-scale production.

properties.name: Berg Aukas Zinc-Vanadium
properties.description: Historic Otavi Mountainland Zn-Pb-V mine (closed 1978) with tailings and remaining resources under evaluation.

properties.name: Walvis Bay Salt Works
properties.description: Solar sea-salt production, a major supplier to the southern African chemical industry.
